thread:
liam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners and dates for the test/eval additions called out. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/RDI-4021
kelly: I can take the regression prompt-set work. Are we trying to capture the fallback tokenization case + the stop-seq regression?
liam: yes — two things: (1) prompt-set that reproduces role-tokenization drift when fallback model used, (2) a stop-seq regression that failed last deploy.
sanjay: I'll pick up load-profile and chaos drills. Can someone confirm the traffic shape? I can add a short ramp-and-spike test in k6.
anya: I'll add the scenario for the forced-model-fallback in the eval harness and add a canary gate in CI. Thinking about a `regression/fallback-role-tokenization` prompt group.
kelly: timeline proposal: prompt-set and unit evals by EOD Thursday, integration into `ci-eval/regression` job by next Tue. Owner: @kelly.
liam: Sanjay, can you target the chaos drill (model fallback + node loss) for next Friday and add the runbook steps? Owner: @sanjay.
sanjay: Yep. I'll create RDI-4100 for chaos drill and link to postmortem. Traffic shape: 95th percentile at 220 rps, spike to 800 rps for 60s. I'll add k6 script snippet: ```js
export default function() {
  http.post(url, {prompt: '...'}, {tags: {route: 'generate'}})
}
```
anya: For the eval harness: I'll add a KV-cache warmup step and include the failing prompts. Also adding an automatic alert in the eval dashboard when top-k token distributions shift > 5%.
kelly: I'll drop the initial prompt examples into `suites/fallback_role_tokenization.json` and add a tiny repro that CI can run in ~20s.
liam: Who's owning the regression triage when CI flags this? We should assign a rotation.
kelly: Suggest rotation: eng-ml on call for regressions during business hours, eng-platform nights/weekends. I can make a simple rota doc.
sanjay: I'll wire the k6 job into our load pipeline and link results to the postmortem ticket. Will also add a failing-rate threshold to surface regressions automatically.
incident-bot: Created ticket RDI-4100 (Chaos drill: fallback + node loss) assigned to sanjay, due 2026-04-10.
anya: Action items recap: (1) kelly: prompt-set + CI integration (due Thu EOD), (2) sanjay: chaos drill + load profile + CI wiring (due 2026-04-10), (3) anya: eval harness changes + alerting (due next Tue), (4) liam: publish rotation doc and add to postmortem as follow-up (due Mon). I'll update the postmortem with links once items are created.
liam: Perfect. Please add the short notes to the postmortem follow-ups section and tag owners. If anything slips, put a comment in the ticket and @liam so I can escalate. :thumbsup:
